name: Decentralized Euro
oneLiner: DEURO is a decentralized euro stablecoin minted from overcollateralized BTC, ETH, and crypto vaults using a Frankencoin-style oracle-free auction mechanism.
collateral: BTC, ETH, and other crypto assets in oracle-free overcollateralized positions
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP with automated liquidation; no oracle dependency (same architecture as Frankencoin ZCHF)

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: DEURO resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

mintAuthority.summary: DEURO is minted permissionlessly by users opening overcollateralized, oracle-free positions in Frankencoin-style minting modules; contracts are immutable but nDEPS protocol-share holders can veto proposals, adjust the savings rate, and approve new minting modules.

controls.label: Frankencoin-style minting module (collateral mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by per-position overcollateralization with oracle-free auction liquidation; users self-mint against approved collateral.
controls.evidence: Anyone can mint dEURO by overcollateralizing crypto in immutable minting-module contracts using the Frankencoin oracle-free auction model.

controls.label: nDEPS veto governance
controls.evidence: Protocol-share (nDEPS) holders use Frankencoin-style veto governance to approve new minting modules and adjust parameters such as the savings rate; new modules can be added that gain mint capability, so the admin surface is not fully renounced.

review.evidence: dEURO is a Frankencoin v2024 fork: contracts are immutable and DFX retains no direct control, but the main contract can onboard new minting modules via nDEPS veto governance, which is a bounded but real authorization surface.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Immutable-contract + veto-governance model confirmed from dEURO/Frankencoin docs; exact deployed module set and nDEPS quorum not independently read on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Enumerate the currently approved dEURO minting modules and the nDEPS veto quorum on-chain.

references.label: dEURO website — MiCA position: qualifies as crypto-asset under MiCA but Titles II–IV not applicable due to no central issuer (LEXR Germany Rechtsanwalts GmbH legal opinion)
